items.q: Is this a sales pitch in disguise?
items.a: No. The call is a working session, and you keep the prioritized plan whether or not we ever work together. If we're not a fit to help you build, we'll say so.

items.q: We're a small team — is AI even applicable to us?
items.a: That's exactly what the audit answers. We look at how your business actually runs and find the three places automation pays off for a team your size — or tell you honestly if now isn't the time.

items.q: Our data is a mess. Do we need to clean it up first?
items.a: No. You don't need clean or organized data to start. We work with what you have and factor the real state of your data into the plan.

items.q: We don't have an AI person. Can our team actually run this?
items.a: Yes. The plan is written in plain English for your existing team. There's no jargon to decode and nothing you have to buy just to understand it.

items.q: Will you try to replace our staff with bots?
items.a: No. We map human-in-the-loop automations that give your people time back. We don't pitch fully autonomous systems or replacing your team.

items.q: What happens to the information we share?
items.a: We use it only to prepare and book your audit. We don't sell it, and we don't feed what you share into any public AI tool.
The call is 30 minutes. After it, you walk away with your ranked plan, and most teams ship their first automation within about two weeks.

changelog: Initial ElevateAI 'AI Opportunity Audit' book-a-call page.

PROOF TO CONFIRM BEFORE GOING LIVE: stats section figures ('40+ SMBs audited', '5–15 hrs/wk across 3–5 automations', '~2 weeks to first automation') are placeholders from allowed proof and must be human-verified before publish. The visitor-facing stats title no longer contains this note.
Voice/compliance: copy avoids revenue/ROI figures, 'replace staff'/'autonomous' claims, named clients, and fake certs/partnerships per brief. Hours-saved is the only quantified payoff axis.
Brand palette set to a trustworthy teal/aqua scheme (brand #0F4C5C, accent #2EC4B6), replacing the default indigo.

v2 — applied review fixes. HIGH: removed offer.rating (fabricated 4.9/40 AggregateRating, invisible to users, no allowed proof) so seo.ts emits no aggregateRating; removed '(figures are placeholders...)' from the visible stats title; replaced fake-scarcity urgency with a truthful by-hand-capacity line. MED: rewrote consentText as a concrete first-person privacy statement with no dangling 'privacy policy' link (no /privacy route exists in the build); de-jargoned 'highest-ROI' to 'worth the most hours' in hero, features, how, offer, lead form, meta and seo; cut redundant hero bullet 3 (duplicate of trust line); reframed testimonials items as positioning labels (role carries the manifesto label) to reduce fake-quote read; anchored a problem pain in named workflows mirroring the form placeholder; reconciled timing claims to the allowed '2 weeks to first automation' proof (removed 'about a week start to finish').

STILL OPEN FOR HUMAN/ENG (not content-only): testimonials component still renders avatar initials + quote marks (Testimonials.tsx) — to fully kill the fake-quote read, drop the avatar/figcaption treatment or change the section type; consentText could link to a real /privacy page once one exists; consider rendering a scheduler inline on the lead-form success state and instrumenting a distinct booked-call event so the optimizer rewards bookings, not form fills.
